properties.name: 緑駅 駅舎

detail_confidence.footprint_position_orientation: C (this session's placement adjacent to the surveyed station point and rail centerline — the spec gives dimensions/shape, not absolute lat/lon; see reconstruction.json)
detail_confidence.roof_pitch_ridge_height: C (not specified by the spec; chosen only to keep the main ridge below the porch apex)
detail_confidence.vertical_boards_count_4: B (secondary_photo, undated — only 2 confirmed in the 2009 photo)

properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §4. Dimensions per §4.1 (container-scale method, see reconstruction.json). Roof pitch/ridge height not given by the spec — a conservative value was chosen only to keep the main ridge below the porch's spec-given 4.8m apex (AC04); this specific rise is NOT sourced. Absolute footprint position/orientation is this session's own placement (adjacent to LOC_MIDORI_STATION and oriented along RAIL_SENMO_KSJ_000's tangent), not given by the spec.

detail_confidence.height_0.75_0.85m: C (inference — spec v1.1 downgraded from a JR-standard-value assumption)
detail_confidence.length_20m: U — drawing-convenience value only, not sourced; spec explicitly leaves platform length Unknown

properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §5. length_m=20 is a rendering convenience with no evidentiary basis (spec: platform length is U) — see evidence/reconstruction.json:STR_MIDORI_PLATFORM_LAYOUT. Lateral position/track-spacing is also this session's placement, since MLIT KSJ N02 records only a single route centerline, not each physical rail.

properties.name: 緑駅 構内踏切
properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §5/§6. Existence and board-crossing material are contemporary_photo/encyclopedia (A/B per spec §5); this feature's exact position/extent (spanning between the two platform footprints) is this session's placement, not surveyed.

properties.name: 緑駅 鉄道コンテナ
properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §8: form/dimensions of the container are Unknown. Rendered as a 12ft-class approximate box per the spec's own explicit instruction (§4.3 of Directive 08): "形式不明、外観から12ft級と推定（C）". Color/rust and presence in the gravel area north of the building are the photo-sourced facts; the box's precise dimensions are not.

properties.name: 緑駅前広場 緑色舗装
properties.note: MIDORI_STATION_REALITY_SPEC v1.1 §8: that the plaza pavement is painted green is confidence A (contemporary_photo). This polygon's extent/shape, however, is this session's own placement convenience — the spec gives no dimensions or surveyed boundary for the plaza, so the feature is held at confidence C overall (the weaker of the two claims bundled into one polygon).
